headline: Assaí Approves Fourth Share Buyback Program for Up to 11 Million Shares
summary: Assaí's board of directors approved its fourth share buyback program, allowing the retailer to acquire up to 11 million common shares over 12 months.
why: Share buyback programs alter a company's capital structure and signal management's view on the valuation of its equity.

impacts.name: Sendas Distribuidora S.A.
impacts.why: A share buyback reduces the number of shares outstanding, potentially impacting earnings per share.
